title: [bundle] Fix CI-found durability test host-ignore contamination: PR #
objective: Fix CI-found durability test host-ignore contamination: PR #224 macOS CI fails `durability::tests::canonical_fragment_alone_is_healthy_and_complete` because the temp git repo can inherit runner/global git ignore state that reports durable .handoff probes as ignored even when the repo has only the canonical fragment. Make the durability tests isolate their temporary repos from host/global excludes (for example local `core.excludesFile /dev/null`) so the test proves the repository fragment itself. Keep the production swallow guard behavior unchanged unless a safer diagnostic-preserving adjustment is necessary. Add or update regression evidence and prove the hf bin durability test and CLI prompt-hub tests are green.
acceptance_criteria: Durability temp git repositories used by tests are isolated from host/global git excludes so canonical-fragment health tests are deterministic across CI runners.
Production swallow-guard behavior is not downgraded.
The specific durability bin test and the prompt-hub CLI regression are green.
Drift audit passes with edits inside task scope.
